title: L Looked Jack In The Eye And Said, I Think You Are Kira . . . (Episode 10)
caption:
In Death Note episode 10, L invites Jack to a tennis match, then tells him to his face that he suspects him of being Kira.
Jack fights back with his brain, until his father collapses and a package lands at a TV station. Follow for episode 11!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Would you have trusted L after he said he suspects you, or walked away? Why?

segments.say: L looks Jack dead in the eye and says, I think you are *Kira*.
To see how it got here, go back to a game of *tennis*.
L has invited Jack to play, just to get to know each *other*.
L says he was once the junior champion of *Britain*.
Jack tries one small question about England, but L tells him to save his *breath*.
One set, first to six. Just a friendly game, L says.
But L has a secret reason. He knows Kira *hates* to lose.
L takes the first point right away. Fifteen *love*.
Meanwhile, Jack's father is in trouble at *headquarters*.
His own men will not tell him a thing. L has ordered them to keep *quiet*.
The big bosses say it has been four months, and the public wants *results*.
The chief fires back. Most detectives would rather let a killer run free than risk their *lives*.
And L, he says, is the one man actually risking his *life*.
Back on the court, a crowd has started to *gather*.
Jack tries to read L. If he wins, he looks like Kira. If he loses on purpose, he looks like a *liar*.
So he makes his choice. He will not let L win, and the ball flies past him. L's eyes go *wide*.
Four games all. In the crowd, someone finds out Jack was a junior high tennis *champion*.
But Jack has already worked out what L will do *next*.
First a trap, then a demand for proof, and then a trip to *headquarters*.
Jack's answer is simple. You cannot win with defense alone. You have to *attack*.
He smashes the final shot. Game and set to *Jack*.

segments.text: Game and set! Won by Light Yagami!

segments.say: L says he expected it all along. Then he drops a *bomb*, right there on the path.

segments.text: I suspect that you, Light Yagami, are in fact Kira.

segments.say: Jack plays dumb. L says it is only a *one percent* chance.
But Jack sees the trap. One percent is just enough to keep him away from the *task force*. L plays dirty, and Jack knows it.
L takes him to his favorite coffee shop, where *nobody* can listen in.
He sits hunched up, knees to his chest. Sitting normally, he says, cuts his brain power by forty *percent*.
Then he slides over photos of notes written by inmates right before they died. None of it was ever made *public*.
Jack solves it in seconds. The first letters of each line spell a message for L. Gods of death love *apples*.
Jack plays the fool and shuffles the photos into a wrong order. Love apples, gods of death. It makes no *sense*.
Then L lowers the hammer. There were four photos, not *three*.

segments.text: Gods of death who love apples have red hands.

segments.say: Jack never wrote that note. It is a *fake*, and L made it just to watch him.
Jack grits his teeth. This was never about the code. L only wanted to see his *reaction*.
Then L asks how Jack would test a suspect. And Jack gives the same answer L would. Get him to say what only Kira *knows*.
L is impressed. But every smart answer makes Jack look *worse*. Three percent now.
L says that whether Jack is Kira or not, having him on the team helps *either way*.
Jack is not buying it. First, he says, prove that you are *L*.
Let my father or the task force confirm it, or I will not *help*.
L smiles. He is working with Jack's father at that very *moment*.
Jack freezes. Does this guy have a death *wish*?
Then both their phones go off, and Jack's world drops. His father has had a heart *attack*.
At the hospital, the chief says he thought it was Kira at first. The doctors say it was just *stress*.
L has told the chief everything. That Jack is a suspect, and that he is *L*.
The chief backs it up. This man is the real L, and the task force calls him *Ryuzaki*.
For a second, Jack thinks about getting rid of L and his whole team. Then he drops it, and plays the worried *son*.
L explains that twelve FBI agents died following people close to the police. Jack's family was on that *list*.
Jack asks to join the *investigation*. He wants to prove once and for all he is not Kira.
But the chief says no. Finish school *first*.
Jack reminds him of his promise. If anything happens, he will find Kira and make sure he *pays*.
His father says he refuses to believe his son could be Kira. This does not look like an *act*.
Then he says something odd. The power to kill is a *curse*, and anyone who holds it will never be happy.
Jack nods like he agrees. That nod was the biggest lie of the *night*.
Later, outside, Jack asks L what it would take to prove he is not *Kira*.
He even offers to be locked up for a month, with no TV and a guard on him around the *clock*.
L says no. A detective cannot take orders from his *suspect*. Just wait, and the truth will come out.
And after hearing him with his father, L admits he is almost *convinced*.
Then L gets in his car and drives away. Jack watches him *go*.
The second he is alone, the mask comes off. Jack has finally met the man behind the letter *L*.
He tells Ryuk he has never once felt cursed. He has never been *happier*.
Thanks to the notebook, he is going to build a perfect *world*.
Ryuk does not care. He leaves that sentimental crap to the *humans*.
But he warns Jack. Humans who touch a death god get nothing but *misfortune*.
Jack always thinks he is the exception.
Meanwhile, across town, a TV producer is yelling at his staff for a good *story*.
The police will not talk, his ratings are dying, and he tells his team to get *creative*.
Then a package lands on his desk. Inside are *tapes*.
He reads the letter, and his eyes light up. A message to the world from *Kira*.
If he does not broadcast the tapes, Kira will kill the company's board, one by *one*.
Kira is about to go on air, and the whole world will be *watching*.
